A federal grand jury in the Northern District of Texas indicted Nelson Bunker Hunt, W. Herbert Hunt, and five other men. The others named are Ralph Shank, Charles Tessmer, B. H. Timmins Jr., Edward J. Hudson, and lawyer Percy Foreman. The charge was conspiracy to obstruct justice, running from January 1970 to February 1973.

The Hunts were among the richest oil families in America, so their indictment drew national notice. An obstruction charge says the defendants worked together to block a legal process. The indictment preserves the government's opening move in that case, names and dates set out in court form.
